verdict.rationale: The only route to natural-language operation is indirect: Stripe documents an official MCP server (stripe-radar-probe-4) that an AI agent could use to turn natural-language requests into calls against Radar's API, such as approving reviews (stripe-radar-docs-21). Machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown pages) support this, but Radar's own rules and review queue are driven through the Dashboard and a rule syntax, not natural language. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Radar operations, a first-party natural-language interface for creating rules or triaging reviews, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
